title: NetworkLoadBalancerPoolPut represents the modifiable fields of a LXD network load balancer pool.

config.description: Load balancer pool configuration map (refer to doc/howto/network_load_balancers.md)

description.description: Description of the load balancer pool.

instances.description: List of instances in the pool.

NetworkLoadBalancerPoolInstance.description: An instance can have multiple targets depending on how many addresses it has in the pool's network.

name.description: The name of the instance in the pool.

target_port.description: Optional target port to override the pool's default target port.

NetworkLoadBalancerPoolInstance.title: NetworkLoadBalancerPoolInstance represents an instance in a load balancer pool.
